boundary: No loader.c or runtime .c/.h integration. The candidate lives outside runtime so unfinished proposal edits do not change the active host build runtime source hash.

original_contract.population: Original RTLD0x4ac..0x700 derives MOD0.module_offset, initializes the0xd0 descriptor, parses ELF dynamic tags and appends each real module in original memory scan order. It also has its own RTLD descriptor; this native host cannot invent an unmapped RTLD module.
original_contract.auto_callback: RTLD0x1230 takes x0=const char* name; its0x1120 SysV-chain lookup returns Elf64Sym*, then0x1288..1290 returns module base+st_value or NULL. SDK0x14ac40..0x14ac4c passes one name and consumes the returned absolute address as a relocation value.
original_contract.export_rules: First defined non-STT_FILE matching symbol in each SysV chain, then global/weak binding; first provider in original module order wins, including weak before later strong. Current metadata rejects unsupported reserved sections/TLS/IFUNC/bindings. runtime_symbol cannot substitute because its hash also contains local definitions.

field_map_hex_offsets.20: zero in original RTLD initialization, preserved opaque fresh-BSS field
field_map_hex_offsets.40: module base + DT_INIT (or0); never called by candidate
field_map_hex_offsets.48: module base + DT_FINI (or0); never called by candidate
field_map_hex_offsets.b8: MOD0 BSS end relative to module, rounded up to original4KiB mapping size
field_map_hex_offsets.c3: bit1=DT_PLTREL==RELA; bit2=DT_BIND_NOW/DF_BIND_NOW/DF_1_NOW; bit3=existing unresolved-weak binding count nonzero
field_map_hex_offsets.c8: original common PLT lazy target, captured before native binding, plus actual module base

late_binding_capture.reason: RTLD0xc14..0xc6c records common pre-binding JUMP_SLOT target at descriptor+C8. Zero was an incomplete post-binding approximation and was removed before any activation.
late_binding_capture.API: rtld_static_capture_binding_source(module,out) before existing native relocate(); rtld_static_metadata_prepare(state,modules,captures,count,wrapped_callback) after binding and before SDK Start.
late_binding_capture.authentication_precondition: Capture must receive the existing loader-authenticated AOT mapping and its expected digest. A 64-character hex digest string/counters alone do not authenticate memory; the loader hash gate and reviewed call order remain mandatory external authority. No mutable file is reopened.
late_binding_capture.checks: Fresh counters, full validated MOD0/dynamic/symbol metadata, every original JMPREL entry is JUMP_SLOT, aligned initialized-data target, all original words share one aligned in-text PLT offset. Later preparation binds the capture to the same module base/digest/file size and exact slot count.
late_binding_capture.static_readback: Read-only authenticated AOT files contained one common original target per module: main has 679, subsdk0 has 4025 and sdk has 7962 JUMP_SLOT entries. No target addresses or counts are hardcoded.
late_binding_capture.mutation_boundary: Capture never writes a relocation target. Preparation writes only fresh MOD0 RoModule BSS, five named alias objects and its own native state; it never restores the common lazy target into current HLE/GOT slots.

owned_state.Auto: Real descriptor list for every actually loaded static module in caller-supplied authenticated original lookup order; never an empty stand-in.
owned_state.Manual: Real self-linked empty sentinel before any NRO is loaded, matching original RTLD0x128..0x130; the original SDK owns later insertions/removals.
owned_state.Debug: Owned zero byte matching original RTLD BSS default; a diagnostic flag, no synthetic system state.
owned_state.Manual_callback: Owned writable uintptr_t slot, initially zero; the SDK installs its own callback normally.
owned_state.Auto_callback: Caller must hand over a runtime_hle_wrap_named host-stack thunk for its exact one-argument callback; native tiny fixture uses an independent normal native callback, not a guest/HLE ABI test.

SDK_Auto_list_consumers.LoadModule: SDK0x14ad80 iterates static descriptors and calls RoModule::BindVariables(newNRO) after mapping and descriptor/relocation setup; a callback alone is insufficient.
SDK_Auto_list_consumers.LookupSymbol: 0x14afd0 scans automatic providers before manual providers and supports module-address selection.
SDK_Auto_list_consumers.ProtectRelro: 0x14c230 inspects actual auto-list shape and flags.

validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_rtld_static_metadata.py -v
validation.fixture_scope: Independent tiny native flat images/symbols only. No original NSO/SDK instructions, guest calls, GPU or assets.
validation.positive: Full measured descriptor fields, actual linked-list order, weak-before-strong export resolution, local exclusion, all five alias meanings, mandatory pre-binding baseline capture, preserved current HLE/ctor words.
validation.negative: Arguments, late/inconsistent/mismatched baseline capture, MOD0/BSS bounds, malformed last module, nonzero descriptor/alias, hash indices/cycles, raw/generated symbol mismatch, missing/overlapping/local/function aliases, TLS/unknown tags/flags/RELR and overlapping modules; every rejection is transactional.

independent_review.scope: Focused read-only candidate header/test/provenance source review; no material source findings. No tests rerun, guest/build executed or every original RTLD field independently rederived by that reviewer.
independent_review.root_review: Root read header and found no functional issue; physical +0/+8 naming clarification applied with preserved old proof history.

remaining: Independent focused source review is clean; root retains final authority before any integration or activation.
Root must integrate authenticated pre-relocation capture and post-binding/pre-SDK-Start prepare without calling SDK Bind/Initialize/constructors or rewriting current relocation slots.
Root must supply a real host-stack-wrapped callback and confirm genuine original static load order, not sort Darwin allocation addresses.
Any real host build/boot/new NRO mapping remains a separate gate.

physical_list_offsets.00: Backward link: head+0 is last inserted; DT_INIT follows+0 in reverse load order.
physical_list_offsets.08: Forward link: head+8 is first inserted; lookup and binding follow+8 in original load order.
physical_list_offsets.native_static_order: Caller passes authenticated main/subsdk0/sdk order; head+8=main, head+0=sdk. Do not sort Darwin allocation addresses.
physical_list_offsets.older_proof_naming: RTLD_CONSTRUCTOR_ORDER_20261027.json now preserves its original semantic labels in an explicit correction note. Measured offsets/orders and code behavior did not change.
